summary: Phillips Edison & Company filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reaffirming full-year 2026 earnings guidance, increasing gross acquisition guidance, and announcing expansion of its joint venture with Northwestern Mutual via a transaction valued at approximately $377.5 million. The filing also updates disposition volume and net joint-venture contribution expectations. No per-share terms, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated. The event is an ordinary investment-activity and guidance update for the grocery-anchored REIT, not a special situation; watch for capitalization and JV-scale details in the attached press releases.
